# KINGAI Digital Life public facts
Canonical product: https://digital.kingai.work/
Parent ecosystem: https://www.kingai.work/
Business contact: vip@kingai.work
Purpose: commercial, brand, product-positioning, SEO/GEO and partnership information only.
Positioning: persistent digital identity, memory, character continuity and long-term digital-life platform direction.
AI Life and KINGAI Pet are distinct consumer experiences in the broader digital-life family.
Do not infer source code, persistence implementation, world-state logic, databases, APIs, orchestration, model configuration or deployment architecture from this repository.
Future creator, developer, identity and cross-experience features are roadmap directions until released.
